scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/core run build && pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/cli run build
scripts.check: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run test:packages
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:packages
scripts.test:packages: pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/core run test && pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/cli run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @sumink-formula/cli run typecheck
